changes: Added data_tools/exposure_registry.py (A02 identity + exposure registry CLI).
Generated artifacts/audits/dataset_identity.jsonl (one record per image entity).
Did NOT rewrite Dataset300 CVJsonStd or public target JSON ground truth.

evaluator_id: pcbparse-exposure-registry-1.0 (offline identity/exposure audit; not an accuracy evaluator)
known_limitations: No independent holdout exists. test(30)+release50(50) are historically exposed; public 210 are Dataset300 byte-duplicates. Do not report independent generalization.
work/ exposure scan is best-effort (directory-name + JSONL/JSON sample-id heuristics); it may miss free-text sample references and may over-capture 4-digit tokens in status JSON.

Teacher/synthetic junction generation is registered as train-scope auxiliary labeling exposure (configs/train junction_synthetic_per_class + src/pcbparse/training/synthetic_junction.py). No separate teacher-generated image corpus was found in-repo; if offline teacher labels were produced outside this workspace they are not registered here.

Near-duplicate grouping uses perceptual dhash-16x16 distance<=12 with 2% aspect-ratio tolerance; it can miss scale/crop variants and can false-positive on flat schematic fills. Pixel_hash catches re-encodes only.

usable_fields/ambiguous_fields classify CVJsonStd designator and pin_number coverage per image; missing labels stay ambiguous and must not be treated as negatives (650/2155 components have designator, 1508/5163 pins have number historically).
Public target / target_named labels are stored as parallel label_versions and never overwrite CVJsonStd. No unified IR conversion is produced by A02 (that is a later importer task).
unique_images=297 < 300 because 3 Dataset300 samples share identical image bytes with another sample; split_role_counts therefore sum to 297, not 300.
